rubric_source.descriptor_note: Criterion names below follow the PDF. Korean descriptors are summaries, not replacements for its exact text.
rubric_source.evidence_note: evidence_needed contains reviewer recommendations for the proposed design, not a list of officially mandatory technologies. Alternative implementations may satisfy the same descriptors.
rubric_source.title: Hackathon Rubric 2026
rubric_source.availability: Organizer-provided reference. Original attachment is not redistributed in this repository.

scoring.rule: No aggregate or winning probability. No evidence is not automatically zero. All target levels are conditional on actual evidence and organizer interpretation.

current_state: Product contract and review governance documented. No runnable product, plugin, actual CSE deployment or LLM execution evidence in this initial foundation.

review_policy.coverage: All 17 criteria assigned to a primary team
review_policy.mode: Affected-criterion review after meaningful changes; full review at milestones during active work

criteria.name: Innovative use of oneM2M
criteria.expert_summary: group、announcement、pollingChannel 등 복합 서비스 하나 이상 사용.
criteria.current_plan: Agent tools use native oneM2M discovery, group/fopt and appropriate selective announcement; capture real requests and per-member results.

criteria.name: Use of appropriate communication protocols
criteria.expert_summary: 통신 조건에 맞게 기기와 애플리케이션이 여러 프로토콜 사용.
criteria.current_plan: Implement native oneM2M MQTT/TLS for device traffic and HTTPS for applications where appropriate; generic MQTT-to-HTTP conversion is not native CSE MQTT evidence.

criteria.name: Innovative scenarios
criteria.expert_summary: 복합 기기-CSE-복수 앱 구조 및 기기/앱의 직접 구현 대신 oneM2M 서비스 기능 활용.
evidence_needed: Real CSE loop with independent application AEs
criteria.caution: Multiple simple sensors plus an actuator alone match the Proficient example, not automatically Expert.
criteria.current_plan: Independent diagnostic, facility-operations and maintenance AEs share actual CSE resources. Codex and the real LLM runner use the same tool/service path.

criteria.name: Quality of Article
criteria.expert_summary: 서비스 개요·하드웨어·가능하면 리소스 설계와 프로토콜·그림/설명에 추가 통찰과 oneM2M 이점 제시.
criteria.current_plan: Explain the generalized product, sourced reference case, profile/adapter boundaries, verified execution and oneM2M benefits in an English public article.

criteria.name: Quality of Video
criteria.expert_summary: 합리적 제작 노력이 보이고 끝까지 볼 만하며 기사에 관심을 주거나 내용을 종합하는 영상.
criteria.caution: The Proficient descriptor explicitly permits real, simulated, or virtual props. Rendered footage does not prove backend execution.
criteria.current_plan: Show supported Codex onboarding and actual model/tool/CSE execution alongside explicitly simulated physical equipment.

criteria.name: Quality of Github
criteria.expert_summary: 기사 없이 목적·빌드·배포·소스 탐색이 가능한 독립 저장소, 기사 링크 포함.
criteria.current_plan: Verify clean-environment setup, declared dependencies, account-free demo, real LLM mode, diagnostics, lifecycle commands and extension examples.

criteria.name: Promotion of oneM2M
criteria.expert_summary: 기사·영상·저장소가 oneM2M의 장점을 잘 설명하는 홍보와 추천 역할 수행.
evidence_needed: Links and attribution to oneM2M resources
criteria.current_plan: Demonstrate adapter-only vendor replacement, unchanged application logic and standard discovery/group/subscription/ACP benefits.

criteria.name: Judge points
criteria.expert_summary: 공개 포럼의 실질적 논의에서 얻은 이점 또는 oneM2M 이해 입증.
evidence_needed: Authentic public technical exchange and its impact
criteria.caution: Administrative questions alone do not satisfy this descriptor. Do not manufacture interactions or post without authorization.
criteria.current_plan: Retain evidence of authentic technical exchanges and resulting improvements. Administrative questions and generated dialogues are insufficient.

criteria.name: Interview points
criteria.expert_summary: 리소스 트리와 이점에 더해 통합 방법론 및 향후에도 oneM2M을 선택할 이유 설명.
evidence_needed: English explanation of architecture and resource tree
criteria.current_plan: Explain the resource tree, standards integration, reusable installation path, AI/tool authorization and actual versus simulated execution.

criteria.name: Security and Privacy
criteria.proficient_summary: 역할별 복수 ACP와 최소권한, 사용 사례에 맞는 프라이버시와 개선 방향 설명.
criteria.current_plan: Secure transports, role-scoped ACP and server-enforced agent actions; protect credentials and verify cross-facility, stale-data and unauthorized-control denials.

criteria.name: Data Interoperability and Discoverability
criteria.expert_summary: semantics/SAREF 또는 SDT(TS-0023) 같은 고급 데이터 모델 사용.
criteria.proficient_summary: flexContainer 모델과 애플리케이션 용도에 맞는 리소스 발견 쿼리 사용.
criteria.current_plan: Explicit adapter mappings plus FCNT/discovery support Proficient. Verify actual SDT or semantic-model scope for an Expert claim; use two vendor adapters and two facility profiles.

criteria.name: CSE Handover & Service Continuity
criteria.expert_summary: 위치·부하·지연·가용성 기반 자동 handover, 상태·구독·보안 문맥 유지/복원, 서비스 중단 또는 데이터 손실 측정.
evidence_needed: Measured service interruption or data loss
criteria.current_plan: Conditional on gateway maintenance or availability needs. Serving-CSE transition, state/subscription/ACP restoration and measured interruption/loss require separate implementation.

criteria.name: oneM2M–MEC Application / VM Deployment
criteria.expert_summary: 프로젝트별 지리·토폴로지와 연동 서비스를 반영한 배포 및 적격 호스트 간 오케스트레이션 시연.
criteria.proficient_summary: AE/CSE/MEC app 또는 VM 배포·등록과 연동/배포 절차 문서화.
criteria.caution: Local Docker or remote Sandbox API access alone does not prove orchestration or platform deployment.
criteria.current_plan: Feasibility investigation accepted. Actual managed deployment, registration, logs and procedure are required; local Docker and app IDs alone are insufficient.

criteria.name: Federated Learning (TR-0084)
criteria.expert_summary: 맞춤 oneM2M 모델로 참여자·데이터/작업·상태·결과 조정, 동적 참여자 선택, 복원력 있는 다중 라운드 학습. ESTIMED VM 사용.
criteria.caution: Both Proficient and Expert explicitly require the ESTIMED VM in this rubric.
criteria.current_plan: Deferred pending a genuine data-locality/learning need, dataset and ESTIMED VM implementation path. Not automatically N/A.

criteria.name: Geolocation Services
criteria.expert_summary: 네트워크/MEC/oneM2M 위치 서비스를 결합해 이동·handover·geofencing·배치·정책 중 사례에 맞는 기능을 지원하고 이벤트 동작 시연.
criteria.current_plan: Deferred pending operational behavior that depends on actual network/MEC location events. Static facility addresses are insufficient.

criteria.name: MEC Services
criteria.expert_summary: oneM2M을 통해 복수 MEC 서비스를 발견·설정·사용하고 양방향 MEC-oneM2M 상호작용 시연.
criteria.proficient_summary: 비위치 MEC 서비스 하나 이상을 oneM2M을 통해 사용.
criteria.caution: Direct MEC API calls beside an independent CSE match the Emerging description. Distinguish sandbox-emulated network information from physical measurements.
criteria.current_plan: Conditional MEC033 platform discovery/provisioning candidate. Confirm real service availability and oneM2M-to-IPE-to-MEC-to-application execution.

criteria.name: AI Agents & MCP Integration
criteria.expert_summary: 복수 도구/MCP 서버를 조정해 복잡한 oneM2M/MEC 작업 흐름 수행, 영속 상태 또는 고급 라우팅.
criteria.proficient_summary: 상태 유지·결과 검증·일반 오류 처리가 있는 다단계 구조화 에이전트.
criteria.caution: Using AI to develop code or generate visuals does not itself satisfy product AI/MCP integration.
criteria.current_plan: Required core: Codex plugin/MCP and real LLM API runner with persistent state, validation, bounded errors and checked CSE outcomes. Fixtures remain separate from live-model evidence.

internal_completion_gates_not_official_r: Fresh supported Codex environment completes guided setup without editing application source.
Plugin installation, MCP connection, runtime startup and actual CSE operation are checked separately.
Account-free deterministic demo reproduces normal operation, exhaust anomaly, missing observation, maintenance action and recovery evidence.
A real LLM API runner completes the same service flow, with tool traces and final CSE outcome verification.
At least two facility profiles use the same core code; first candidates are a cooking/food-production area and a meeting/classroom ventilation example.
At least two vendor adapters with different field/unit formats use the same application/tool code.
Role/ACP denials, stale data, wrong tool arguments, duplicate requests and bounded error recovery have meaningful checks.
README, diagnostics, stop/restart and cleanup instructions are verified independently.
Simulated physical data, actual CSE/MCP/model execution and unsupported real equipment are labeled honestly.
open_questions: Track-specific applicability, weights, aggregation and N/A policy are unverified.
Managed MEC hosting permissions and authenticated service instances were not available; reviewed product-scope deferrals are not official N/A.
Public article/video posting and actual judge participation remain separate handoff actions.

references.purpose: Official event purpose, language and licensing
Reference-case reporting on school-kitchen ventilation deficiencies
Codex plugin packaging and local authoring guidance

claim_boundaries: School kitchens are a reference example, not the product domain limit.
News supports reported ventilation deficiencies, not a causal claim that vendor fragmentation caused them.
Physical readings and equipment behavior are simulated until separately validated.
Fan command ACK does not prove actual exhaust performance.
No clinical benefit, certified ventilation performance or production readiness is claimed.
MCP/LLM integration is distinct from MEC; LLM calls are not federated learning.
assessment_note: Original criteria/descriptors retained. Current implementation evidence map: docs/hackathon/current-assessment.md. Final independent release review is pending; no official score assigned.
